description.en: Custom firmware mods for the UC Remote 3. Mod 1: configurable charging-screen screensaver with Matrix rain, Starfield, Minimal, Analog, and TV Static themes. Mod 3: compact battery indicator on every entity / activity detail page (v1.4.21 adds a sibling WiFi indicator with a Settings → UI toggle). Mod 4: WiFi UX bundle — live link diagnostics, always-visible signal indicator, reconnect button, WoWLAN toggle on UCR3. Mod 5: Active Session Keeper — resets the device's sleep countdown every 4.5 min via set_power_mode(NORMAL) pings while a media player is actively playing or recent media-control buttons are pressed. Mod 6: Phantom-Wake Suppressor — forces the device back to LOW_POWER if a wake event happens with no user input within a configurable grace window, eliminating WoWLAN-induced phantom-wake battery drain (v1.4.22 fixed the API call format that had silently broken Mod 5/6 since their respective releases; v1.4.23 added recent-input lookback to handle wake-press timing). Wake-replay HUD: post-wake reconnect banner — v1.4.21 made it more prominent (120 px height, font 32, brighter color, subtle pulse). v1.4.33 fixes a 70-second Settings → Power open delay caused by upstream Slider's tick Repeater over-instantiating thousands of invisible Rectangles when slider ranges are large (root cause v1.4.26 missed). v1.4.34: QML test coverage for BatteryStatusChip / WifiStatusChip / ReconnectingHUD overlays — closes the largest contiguous block of zero-coverage custom UI per the audit roadmap (B5). v1.4.35: HUD test fix — `SequentialAnimation on opacity` and `RotationAnimation on rotation` register as property value sources, not children/resources, so they're unreachable via findByObjectName traversal. Replaced with binding-chain test on `hud.active`. Also bundles `images.qrc` into test resources (silences spurious loader_small.png warning). v1.4.36: B1 matrixrain decomposition — largest single-file refactor in the project's history. matrixrain.cpp 1445 → 746 LOC (-48 %) across three architectural phases. New helpers in `src/ui/matrixrain/`: SingleLayerRenderer (Phase A — stateless render path, mirrors LayerPipeline), InputHandler (Phase B — QObject-with-timers, owns enter-button state machine + 2 internal timers, mirrors ActivitySessionKeeper / PhantomWakeSuppressor), BindingHelper (Phase C — all-static, 8 ScreensaverConfig binding helpers, mirrors AtlasBuilder). Five collaborator classes total in `src/ui/matrixrain/`. QML contract preserved verbatim. Each phase independently CI-green and visually verified on UCR3. Also bundled: C1 ScreensaverConfig Battery-deferred-connect cleanup (drops `QTimer::singleShot(500, ...)` retry hack via `main.cpp` construction reorder; `Q_ASSERT(batt && ...)` regression net), STYLE_GUIDE §1.4 AP-UC-13 extension on Repeater `model:` gating (cheap-hygiene combo with `visible:`), 3× description text consistency sweep (`colors.medium` → `colors.light`). v1.4.37: audit-driven hygiene cleanup (path to A−). Doc/test only — zero binary changes; install bundle ships byte-identical binary to v1.4.36 with an updated release.json. Closes 4 audit findings: 9 `verify(true, "...")` fake smoke tests in integration suites replaced with observable post-state assertions (SignalSpy patterns, +10 net real assertions); BUILD.md drops a previous developer's macOS user path and adds Windows + Git-Bash Docker invocation; STYLE_GUIDE §1.11 documents auto-revert as a crash safety net (NOT a validation review — uses the v1.4.22 setPowerMode silent failure as case study); A11Y_AUDIT.md gets its first audit pass (static analysis only — page existence, KeyNavigation chain counts, font sizing sweep, touch-target dimension check; manual on-device items explicitly deferred to v1.4.38). v1.4.38: test-only CI fix for v1.4.37 — the N4 rewrite encoded a wrong assumption about InputHandler architecture (`interactiveInput()` is the imperative-dispatch path that doesn't go through the `enterAction` signal). Binary identical to v1.4.37; release exists solely to attach a green CI run to the latest tag.
